title: Default output for range sliders in the active refinements list needs some love
body:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/jwqymgx290qxay0/Screenshot%202016-06-12%2011.34.36.png?dl=0

^ This is the current output.

Could be something like "1 < attribute < 3" or "attribute: 1 to 3"

comments.body:
This is a general issue about numeric filters on an attribute don't you think? Yet linked to the rangeSlider in your example.

And yes we could by default fix that
The new connector API will let the users completly customize the output of the currentRefinement widget. This is not out-of-the-box but it will be possible to reformat / aggregate the values.
